# Did an extension you already trust just change what it does?

> Paste a snapshot of your installed VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, or VSCodium extensions and see exactly which ones changed their activation surface -- a new startup trigger, a new extension dependency, or a changed entry point -- since your last check.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
